code:
1. Set accountEnabled = false on the application
   (blocks every credential tied to it at once)
2. Delete every client secret, including the added one
3. Issue one new secret -> store it in Key Vault
4. Cut Graph permissions down to read-only finance scope
caption: Disable sign-in immediately -- don't wait for the full credential list review to finish.
